properties.name: drop_down_mode
properties.comment: Menu mode routes the whole button to the drop-down; split mode keeps a primary Click region and a disclosure region at drop_down_edge. An unknown mode throws std::invalid_argument and changes nothing.
hand: written forgets a pointer-opened drop-down before invalidating

properties.name: drop_down_width
properties.comment: The disclosure extent on drop_down_edge, 12 to 64 (default 16); a write moves the reserved content inset with it, so author primary-content padding after it. A value outside that range throws std::invalid_argument and changes nothing.
hand: a view: the write moves content_padding by the change from the old width

properties.name: drop_down_edge
properties.comment: The edge holding the disclosure region, right (default) or bottom; a write moves the reserved content inset to it. An unknown edge throws std::invalid_argument and changes nothing.
hand: a view: the write moves the reserved inset from the old edge to the new one
